jordan: Hey team — customer 8672 hit a hard failure when using JSON mode / structured output. Their backend validator errors with "Type mismatch: expected number got string". They say it started after the model upgrade last night. Example response attached.

alex: Can you drop the request_id and the raw model response? Also which API (hosted/dedicated/private)?

jordan: Hosted. request_id=01F8XGZ9QKZ4X1R3P4Y0K7A2. Raw snippet from the model:```
{
  "order_id": "A-332",
  "total": "123.45",
  "paid": "false",
  "status": "Active",
  "items": [{"sku":"X9","price":"12.34","quantity":"1"}]
}
```
Customer's validator log: `ValidationError: Type mismatch: expected number at $.items[0].price (got string)`. They treat status enum as lowercase (`active`) and booleans must be true/false not strings.

samira: Ugh, this is the classic stringified-numbers/booleans problem. Two immediate asks: 1) can you repro locally with the same model version? 2) if so, can you collect model_version from the /info header?

jordan: Repro steps below (curl). We can repro reliably. Model version header: `x-redwood-model: rwd-instruct-v2.1`. Curl repro:```
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"mode":"json_schema","schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"total":{"type":"number"},"paid":{"type":"boolean"},"status":{"type":"string","enum":["active","pending","cancelled"]}},"required":["total","paid"]},"input":"Summarize order"}'
```
The returned body (above) shows numbers and booleans serialized as strings and enum casing changed.

alex: Thanks. Two possible workarounds while we investigate: 1) enable lenient parsing on the validator that coerces numeric/boolean strings to native types, 2) run a quick post-processor on responses to coerce types. Example JS coercion we shipped to one customer:```
const payload = JSON.parse(responseText);
payload.items = payload.items.map(i => ({...i, price: parseFloat(i.price), quantity: parseInt(i.quantity,10)}));
payload.total = parseFloat(payload.total);
payload.paid = payload.paid === 'true' || payload.paid === true;
```
Note this is a temporary hack — we shouldn't rely on it.

ingrid: Team - eng-runtime here. We saw a drift in the JSON-mode serializer after rwd-instruct-v2.1 promotion. Looks like the commit that added a generalized string-escape path ended up stringifying primitive outputs in some schema flows. I'm triaging now. If confirmed, we'll push a hotfix to the JSON-mode output formatter.

support-bot: Created ticket RED-5781 for this escalation (linked to request_id 01F8XGZ9QKZ4X1R3P4Y0K7A2). SLA: P1. Assigned to eng-runtime + devex.

mike-billing: Heads-up — customer 8672 is on a time-limited trial. They've retried ~8 times which bumped token usage. If we accept this was our regression we should consider crediting the overage. I'll hold charges pending resolution.

jordan: Customer-facing repro checklist I gave them: 1) curl above, 2) capture full response headers (x-redwood-model etc), 3) attach request_id, 4) try falling back to the previous pinned model if on Dedicated. They already tried fallback and it worked (pinned to rwd-instruct-v2.0).

samira: DevEx note — add a short-run mitigation doc to the support KB: how to coerce types and how to toggle lenient parsing in console. I'll draft a blurb. Also documenting that enum casing can change after model upgrades.

ingrid: Action plan: (1) rollback the serializer commit for JSON-mode in staging for a quick revert test (~1h), (2) run regression tests across schema variants, (3) if green, hotfix rollout to hosted within 3–4 hours with monitoring. If rollback not feasible we'll push a targeted serializer patch. I'll post status in 30m.

alex: For support thread — please capture the customer's failure stack and attach RED-5781. I'll push the lenient parser toggle to the customer's org temporarily: console > org settings > Feature Flags > lenient_json_mode = true. That will avoid the 400 failures.

jordan: Customer accepted the toggle for now. They're a bit nervous about token spikes; asked for billing note.

mike-billing: I'll proactively credit the extra retries for this week pending root cause. Marking account 8672 for manual review.

support-bot: RED-5781 updated: status=investigating, assignees=[ingrid, alex, samira], priority=P1. ETA comments added.

jordan: Will follow up with the customer tonight after the hotfix/rollback. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

ingrid: quick follow for transparency: root cause suspected = JSON-mode serializer path returning JSON.stringify on primitives in some codepaths. Not a schema validation change.

alex: Logged internal postmortem template under /incidents/RED-5781 — fill it as we close.

samira: I'll add KB + quick code snippets to the support playbook.

jordan: Closing note from customer: they want enum casing guaranteed — asked for a contract note. We'll coordinate legal if this needs SLA.

ingrid: Acknowledged. If we ship a change, we'll ensure stable behavior across promotions and add a test to the model promotion checklist. :eyes:
